mechanism: Deutetrabenazine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and clindamycin may have minor effects on CYP450 metabolism; additive CNS effects possible with deutetrabenazine's dopamine-depleting action affecting neuropsychiatric status.
action: Monitor for increased dystonia, akathisia, depression, or suicidal ideation; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical vigilance recommended.
